title: Mozambique entrusts small solar panel factory to UAE’s Jampur Group
summary: UAE-based Jampur Group has been selected to manage and modernize Mozambique’s Beluluane Solar Panel Factory, which suspended production around 2022 due to technological limitations and market competition. The initiative aims to revive domestic solar panel manufacturing, improve competitiveness and create local employment opportunities. The post Mozambique entrusts small solar panel factory to UAE's Jampur Group appeared first on pv magazine Global .
